notes.title: Small Update 12/5/2024
notes.content:
Levels now unlock upon completing the previous level (regardless of number of guesses used).
Level select updated to make unfinished levels clearer.
Various small bugfixes.

notes.title: Minor Update - 14/7/2023
notes.content:
Chaos omens now have help text.

Fill command ('F' key) now works correctly for "From the Center" and "Spreading Moss"

Special thanks to LoyalDeath for reporting these bugs!

notes.title: Minor Update - 30/6/2023
notes.content: Daily omens (mushrooms at the bottom of the menu) unlock earlier.

notes.title: Achievement Patch 22/05/2023
notes.content: 2 new achievements added for Pale Moon content.

notes.title: The Pale Moon Update
notes.content:
This update adds 22 new omens, including:
[list]
[*]2 sets of handcrafted puzzles early on to help new players learn the game.
[*]New speed omens, including a new type where time is added whenever you clear a symbol.
[*]Procedurally-generated omens that challenge you to solve them in a single guess.
[*]Omens where the solution keeps changing as you solve it.
[*]And many more...
[/list]
The update also adds a new visual effect that make it clearer when you have completed a symbol.

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch 23/03/2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards now display for daily omens (mushrooms on the shore).
[*]Reworked tutorial to be clearer.
[*]Added list of shortcuts to "?" page during gameplay.
[*]Number of guesses and guesses needed to pass now always visible.
[*]Various small bug fixes and interface improvements.
[/list]
